meta.methodology: Quality-adjusted market index. Weekly observations are the atomic series; longer candles aggregate weekly index observations. No synthetic historical path is generated.

historyPolicy.backfilled: Allowed only when a dated historical source provides enough observations.
historyPolicy.modelled: Never mixed into observed candles; must be labelled separately.
